name: North Macedonia
description: North Macedonia from Paeonia and Ohrid to the Byzantine, Bulgarian and Ottoman years, Yugoslavia, independence in 1991 and the new name of 2019.

checkpoints.name: Ancient and medieval
checkpoints.note: Paeonians, Macedonians and Romans held the land. Ohrid was a centre of Slavic learning and Samuel's capital.

checkpoints.name: Ottoman rule
checkpoints.note: The Ottomans ruled for five centuries. The rising of 1903 was crushed.

checkpoints.name: Yugoslavia
checkpoints.note: Serbia took the land in 1913. It became a republic of Yugoslavia, and Skopje was rebuilt after 1963.

checkpoints.name: Independent North Macedonia
checkpoints.note: Independence came in 1991. The country took a new name in 2019 and joined NATO in 2020.
